newsitem.title: OMAN: Oman banks' capital base swells 24 percent in year.
newsitem.headline: Oman banks' capital base swells 24 percent in year.

text.p: The capital base of Oman's 18 local and foreign banks grew 24.2 percent in the year to end-March, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.
"The capital base of Oman's commercial banks grew by 24.2 percent to 232.2 million rials from 186.9 million rials on March 31, 1996," the statement said.
"Commercial banks' assets and liabilities amounted to 2.475 billion rials by the end of March 1997 from 2.113 billion rials by the end of March 1996," the statement said.
It said bank credit extended to the commercial sector grew 21.6 percent to 1.76 billion rials on March 31, 1996.
The statement said commercial banks invested 137 million rials in securities in the period from a previous 118 million.
Customer deposits were put at 1.72 billion rials from 1.48 billion rials.
